comparison.objective: Tare a balance and dose granules to 1.00 g behind a draft shield; candidate transfers a bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests door sequencing, container placement, incremental pouring, and feedback-based mass dosing. Candidate tests bimanual support mating and force-limited mechanical sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Record scores correct tare state, final indicated mass, closed shield, and absence of spilled granules. Candidate scores complete block transfer with every ball retained and no support gap or contamination.
comparison.reason: Loose-particle dosing and measurement sequencing are materially different from containing rolling elements inside a translating recirculating block.
